summary: The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index includes companies that enable remote users to access online content; publish online content; participate in prospective wagering; spectate or participate in competitive video gaming; and that provide the products, services and technology that are necessary for the streaming and gaming industries. The fund is non-diversified.
